prior_art.basis: Independent review by claude-independent-prior-art-reviewer-20261106: No home robot cooks, cleans and tidies autonomously like a human helper, so the Main KPI of 500,000,000 households is unmet. The leading consumer humanoid, 1X NEO, opened $20,000 preorders for 2026 delivery and relies on remote human teleoperators for tasks it cannot do alone; an analysis found no independently verified customer deliveries by July 2026 (https://www.eweek.com/news/1x-neo-humanoid-home-robot-2026/, https://ai2.work/blog/1x-neo-ships-into-homes-with-a-human-teleoperator-still-inside). The best open policy work, Physical Intelligence's pi0.5 with openpi code, cleans kitchens and bedrooms in new homes as research (https://www.pi.website/blog/pi05). On the BEHAVIOR-1K household benchmark the 2025 winner reached only about 12 percent full-task success (https://behavior.stanford.edu/challenge/archive/2025/index.html). Moley's robot kitchen claims market entry but has missed launches since 2018 (https://www.moley.com/about-us/). Honest limit: openpi and BEHAVIOR are open baselines, so tasks replicating them are known work; reliability, safety and cost are open.
